|lore=Pilots are often reassigned at the last minute for a variety of tactical reasons. Darth Vader ordered DS-61-2 and DS-61-3 to accompany him to the Battle of Yavin.

|rulings=* If this card removes a unique permanent pilot, that persona's uniqueness still applies (e.g. if played on [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]], the character [[Dutch]] still cannot be deployed).<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 49, explains that removing a unique permanent pilot does not remove the starship's underlying persona; p. 92, "Starships - Unpiloted," suspends game text except deployment text, text stating that the ship "deploys and moves like a starfighter," capacity, permanent astromech identity, ship-docking capability and maintenance costs. These six exceptions limit the blanket wording of the article's unpiloted-text statement; that wording is preserved here. The [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json] Come With Me record (GEMP ID 2_118, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab) records the permanent-pilot and restored-piloting examples; those examples do not remove the general-rule exceptions. These are separately sourced rules, not changes to the original printed card text. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Come%20With%20Me Scomp: Come With Me].</ref>
* An unpiloted starship cannot use its game text (e.g. [[Lando In Millennium Falcon]] cannot use the immune to attrition &lt; 5 text), but once the starship is piloted again, the starship's game text becomes usable again (except text that specifically says it comes from the removed permanent pilot).
